evidence.text: "51 years ago, the Supreme Court ruled in Row v Wade. Today, instead of celebrating, American women are fighting for rights and freedoms that were stripped away. Michelle Steel has made her position clear: she supports a national abortion ban with no exceptions: I don't. I am 100% pro-choice."

"Derek will stand up for women and women’s rights in Congress. As the father of a young daughter, Derek is 100% pro-choice and will stand strong to protect funding for Planned Parenthood and access to critical women’s health services like birth control and cancer screenings."
